label: 4K streaming box, wired + wireless
description: Third-generation Apple TV 4K with the A15 Bionic, 128 GB of storage, Gigabit Ethernet and Wi-Fi 6. The 128 GB model is the one that ships with the Ethernet port; the 64 GB model is Wi-Fi only.
notes: Both wired (gigabit Ethernet) and wireless (Wi-Fi 6 802.11ax 2.4/5 GHz) - the 128 GB SKU is the wired variant, the 64 GB SKU is not. No PoE. Prefers Ethernet when both are up and keeps the Wi-Fi association as a standby path.
